SBIN|2003-06-30..2003-12-31.evidence: BSE aspx Flag=Old Mar-2004 (qtrid 41) prints RBI's block as 'Persons acting in Concert 314,338,700 = 59.73%' with Sub Total 59.73 before 'Non Promoter's Holding' (institutions: MF 5.63 + Banks/FI/Ins 6.00 + FIIS 11.46 = 23.09). The Dec-2003 page (qtrid 40) re-read 2026-09-05 with the fixed parser reproduces the STORED cell exactly (prom 0.0, dii 70.93), i.e. that filing places the RBI 59.73% inside 'Banks, Financial Institutions, Insurance Companies'. Filer-side classification change between Dec-2003 and Mar-2004, same class as the HAL Sep-2021 LIC misfiling (runbook §22, memory project-stocks-hal-sep2021-dii-heal) with the direction reversed: a PROMOTER block sitting in dii. A DII screen sees SBIN at ~71% DII in 2003.
SBIN|2003-06-30..2003-12-31.next_rung: read the page's 'greater than 1% Shareholding' sub-page for Jun/Sep/Dec-2003 to get RBI's exact share count, then heal dii = lump - RBI and prom = RBI via shp_cell_fix.json (row-identity proof per quarter); the Mar-2004 cell held here is consistent with that convention and can land once the neighbours are healed.

JSL|2008-06-30.note: the SAME aspx page re-read with the current parser gives fii 15.17 / dii 9.91 against the stored 9.01 / 16.07 — the stored cell looks like a swapped or mis-summed read from the pre-fix parser (Foreign MF / Foreign FI rows).
